title: Conjunction of trajectory properties
statement: Let $C$ be a contract, and let $R$ and $R'$ be predicates on its data, starting configurations, and work-head position vectors. If both predicates hold at every time up to and including the contract duration for every starting configuration in the entry state satisfying the precondition, then their conjunction also holds at every such time.
replaced:
Let $C$ be a contract for a machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $R$ and $R'$ be
properties of a parameter, a starting configuration, and the vector of work-tape head
positions. If both properties hold at every time up to and including the contract
duration, for every starting configuration satisfying the entry-state and precondition
hypotheses, then their conjunction also holds at every such time.
